leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a reactive color state using Vue's ref API
Implement a color input element and bind it to the reactive state
Configure a color preview display that updates dynamically with the selected color
Apply computed properties to convert hex color values to RGB format
Integrate multiple color input methods (hex, RGB sliders) into a single component
Manipulate the DOM to display real-time color changes in the preview area
Initialize a color picker component with default values and validation
